description: This file defines the 'Styles' class responsible for reading and applying style data in the Gnumeric format within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It handles style regions, style ranges, and conversions of style attributes into PhpSpreadsheet style arrays.

classes.name: Styles
classes.description: A class providing functionality to read and parse style information from Gnumeric files into PhpSpreadsheet style arrays, including handling of style regions, borders, fills, fonts, and alignment.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Styles object with a Spreadsheet instance and a readDataOnly flag.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads style data from a SimpleXMLElement representing a sheet's style elements, processing style regions.

methods.name: readStyles
methods.description: Processes a style region XML element, applying styles to the specified cell range.

methods.name: addBorderDiagonal
methods.description: Adds diagonal border style to the style array if specified.

methods.name: addBorderStyle
methods.description: Adds border style for a given direction if specified in XML.

methods.name: calcRotation
methods.description: Calculates the rotation angle for text based on style attributes.

methods.name: addStyle
methods.description: Maps a style attribute value to its corresponding PhpSpreadsheet constant for a given key.

methods.name: addStyle2
methods.description: Assigns style attribute value to a nested style key if it exists in mappings.

methods.name: parseBorderAttributes
methods.description: Parses border attributes from XML into a style array.

methods.name: parseGnumericColour
methods.description: Converts Gnumeric colour string to a hex RGB string.

methods.name: addColors
methods.description: Adds font and fill colours to style array based on style attributes.

methods.name: readStyleRange
methods.description: Calculates cell range string from style attributes.

methods.name: readStyle
methods.description: Builds a style array from XML style attributes and related style XML elements.
